scalars.scalar_value: Experience producing print and digital visual communications in a high-volume marketing, communications, public agency, education, or institutional setting.

items.item_text: Experience producing print and digital visual communications in a high-volume marketing, communications, public agency, education, or institutional setting.

Experience designing brand-consistent and accessible print and digital communications across multiple platforms, including social media, web, email, advertising, publications, presentations, signage, and promotional materials.

Experience preparing production-ready files for print and digital communications, including typography, layout, color management, prepress, specifications, vendor coordination, and accessibility (ADA/WCAG) best practices.
Experience collaborating with multiple clients or stakeholders, managing multiple projects simultaneously, and meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Photography, photo editing, and basic video editing experience are desirable.
Demonstrated proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud and current design tools, with the ability to learn and apply emerging design technologies and workflows.
